stages.title: The Digital Beacon
stages.locationHint: Head to the Main Entrance Lobby near the Welcome Digital Kiosk. Look closely near the base of the interactive display pillar.
stages.puzzleQuestion: I am a cryptographic protocol that secures communication over the internet, succeeding SSL. What is my 3-letter acronym?

stages.title: The Core Datacenter
stages.locationHint: Navigate to Level 2, Computer Lab 3. Inspect the server rack labeled "SWITCH-ALPHA" next to the network patch panel.
stages.puzzleQuestion: In computer science, I am an abstract data type that serves as a collection of elements with First-In, First-Out (FIFO) retrieval. What am I?

stages.title: The Quantum Vault
stages.locationHint: Make your way to the Innovation Hub Seminar Hall. Look behind the presenter podium corner on the right wing.
stages.puzzleQuestion: I am the cryptographic hash function designed by the NSA that produces a 256-bit digest, used universally in Bitcoin & Git. What is my name?
